newsitem.title: USA: Northeast Bancorp Q3 March 31 net rises.
newsitem.headline: Northeast Bancorp Q3 March 31 net rises.

text.p: Northeast Bancorp said on Friday that net income for its third quarter ending March 31 was $450,989, up from $301,805 for the same quarter the year before.
For the first nine months of fiscal 1997, Northeast had net income of $1.2 million, matching the $1.2 million it reported for the same period in 1996.
As the result of a regulatory decision to assess a special premium on certain insured deposits, the bank had a one-time charge of $380,000 during the first quarter of 1997.
During the second quarter of 1997, due to a legislative decision enabling certain institutions to apply for a 20 percent discount, Northeast had a one-time credit of $83,140.
Northeast has assets of about $250 million.
